title: Detect It Easy 3.21 console macOS ARM64
redistribution: Unmodified DiE 3.21 console/signature database and the five dynamically linked Qt 6.11.0 frameworks required by diec. MIT engine/component notices, Qt LGPL-3.0 and third-party terms are embedded; exact matching DiE source with its bundled submodules and all three relevant Qt source archives are retained in this release. Frameworks remain replaceable in a copied external installation; NOTICE.txt explains reselection. No GUI or installer is executed. Managed bundle requires macOS 13+ ARM64. Signature scan errors remain visible as partial classifications.
